snippet.title: Baseball Pronami Kusayakyuu! (PS1) - Gameplay
snippet.description: This is a full game of the budget PlayStation baseball game Baseball Pronami Kusayakyuu (Pro-Level Sandlot Baseball). Developed by Now Production, released in 2002. Versions of this same game were also released as Big League Slugger Baseball (in North America) and Wai Wai Kusayakyuu.
